description: Backup policy of the on-prem deployment (CR-04-28, HSKT YCK.06): pgBackRest full, differential and incremental backups on day, week and month cycles, a continuous WAL archive to a second site, a monthly archive repository with its own bucket and credentials, an offline copy, immutable (object lock) and encrypted, restore drilled every quarter with a ledger of evidence. scripts/backup-verify.mjs checks every file named here against this policy; infra:check runs the same checks.

incremental.description: incremental backup every four hours, between the daily fulls

differential.description: weekly differential backup: shortens the restore chain of the incrementals that follow it (the daily full stays, it keeps the restore inside the RTO)

monthly.description: monthly full backup into the archive repository (repo2): own bucket, own credentials, own pass phrase, object lock for a year

wal.description: every WAL segment is archived as it completes and the segment is forced to switch at least every 60 seconds

verify.description: weekly pgbackrest verify: reads the repository and checks every file against its checksum

encryption.transport: TLS 1.2 or newer to the object store

archive.description: Old data is archived by the monthly full backup into repository 2 and kept for twelve months; a restore from the archive uses the same pgBackRest commands with --repo=2.

offlineCopy.medium: write-once or disconnected media written from the archive repository after each monthly full backup

manualBackup.note: A manual backup is requested in the admin screen, approved by a second person and run by the host runner; the API never runs a backup.
